title: Who Licks the Cake?
lines: Mom and Jane bake a big cake.
They set it on a plate and go in.
Jake the cat hops up on the gate.
He gets a lick of that cake!
Mom said, "We can make a small cake."
They bake it, and Jake laps it up.
They take the big cake in on its plate.

questions.ask: What does Jake the cat do to the big cake?
questions.listenFor: He takes a lick of it. If they just say "he ate it," ask them to find the line and read what he really did.

questions.ask: How do Mom and Jane fix the problem?
questions.listenFor: They bake a small cake just for Jake. Listen for them naming the small cake, not only "they were nice."

questions.ask: What do you think Jake will do next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any guess is fine if it has a reason from the story, like "go back to the gate, because he wants more cake."
